text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rrrrring!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My alarm goes off, signaling the start of
a new
day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After getting everything ready, I set off
for the
training track.
choice_data_list: 今日もウマ娘と共に切磋琢磨していこう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's keep striving and improving alongside our Umamusume today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tracen is holding scrimmages today, and
the
track is full of Umamusume running
around to
warm up before the races.
I couldn't have put it better myself! ♪
choice_data_list: みんな、夢のために頑張ってるな
みんな、夢のために頑張ってるね
choice_data_list_en: Everyone's working hard for their dreams, huh.
Everyone's working hard for their dreams, aren't they.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
This is truly a treasure trove of talent!

Umamusume worth treating, as far as the
eye can
see! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! ♪ Now who shall I start with?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what?! Hold up! I'm an ally to all

Umamusume! I swear, my sharp needles
can boost
their powers to fearsome—
choice_data_list: たづなさーん！ここに不審者が！！
choice_data_list_en: Tazuna-saaan! There's a suspicious person over here!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on, I'm not dangerous at all!
Why, as a
result of my intensive training,
I've even massively
improved the speed I
can roll up hand towels!
choice_data_list: やっぱり危険じゃないですか！
choice_data_list_en: See, that IS dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hrnnngh... All right, how about this—let
me give
you a demonstration! I'll show
you just how safe
my treatment is and
blow all your worries away!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Look, I'll even control my urge to poke
people
until you give me your seal of
approval, okay?
Please?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Yesss! ♪ Now with that out of the way,
let's bring
you closer to being an
Umamusume! ☆
choice_data_list: わかりました、お付き合いします！
じゃ、じゃあ様子を見ながらで……
遠慮しておきます！！
choice_data_list_en: Understood, I'll join you!
T-Then let's see how things go first...
I think I'll pass!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What're you staring at me all
dumbfounded
for?
choice_data_list: ……ウマ娘に……近い存在……？
choice_data_list_en: ...An existence... close to an Umamusume...?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
My acupuncture is for Umamusume, so I
need
testimonials from subjects as close
to the target
demographic as I can get.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense! To become like an
Umamusume, all
you have to do is train
like one! Probably! ♪
choice_data_list: ごもっともですが……無理じゃないですか？
choice_data_list_en: You're quite right, but... isn't that impossible?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Let's get going, Trainer... Or rather,

<username>!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
If it's speed you want, an exercise bike is

everything you need! Go, go, gooo!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Faster, faster! Let me see you up that
cadence!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Next on the list is backstroke! Swim until
all your
limbs go numb! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Yup, yup! That's it—keep up the good
form! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Finally, we gotta work on your abs to
increase
your overall strength! One, two,
three, four! Don't
you worry anymore!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up! Why? Because you're not
training
alone!
choice_data_list: （さ、さすがにきつくなってきた……）
choice_data_list_en: (T-That's really starting to take a toll...)

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Believe in the power of your friendship...
with me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea what she's saying, but it's
certainly
reassuring to know I'm not
alone in this.
choice_data_list: ゆ、友情……？
choice_data_list_en: F-Friendship...?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is just like the training I did before
with
<chrname>...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Wow, wow, wow! What a great success,
if I do say
so myself! ☆ Now that's what I
call friendship
training! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Good job! ☆ Looks like your training has
paid
dividends! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh c'mon, don't play dumb! We're
finally able to
get to the main event
now!
choice_data_list: あの……どうして保健室に？
choice_data_list_en: Um... why are you in the infirmary?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Now that you're done with training... let
me give
you a little poke! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Relax, relaaax! It'll be quick and
painless, so don't
you worry! ☆
choice_data_list: ま、まだ心の準備が……！！
choice_data_list_en: I-I'm not mentally prepared yet...!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Annnd poke!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Puncture Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Strangely enough, my body feels much
lighter!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that expression on your face...
You're
kidding... It actually worked?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: I did it! I knew I was a genius! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna keep this up and perform even
more
successful treatments! You do your
best in
becoming an Umamusume too,
'kay? ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Well?! Didn't that needle pin you right
where you
needed it? Do you feel it
working its magic deep
down?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! No way—are you telling me it worked too well?!
choice_data_list: ビビビっと……体がしびれて……
choice_data_list_en: Bzzzt... My whole body went numb...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, there's always next time!
Shrug it
off! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You might be unable to move for a
while, but get
well soon! Anyway, see
you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since I can't do anything but lie there, I
use the
time to go over the training plan
I have in mind
for
<chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Yesss! ♪ Now with that out of the way,
let's bring
you closer to being an
Umamusume! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What're you staring at me all
dumbfounded
for?
choice_data_list: ……ウマ娘に……近い存在……？
choice_data_list_en: ...An existence... close to an Umamusume...?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
My acupuncture is for Umamusume, so I
need
testimonials from subjects as close
to the target
demographic as I can get.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense! To become like an
Umamusume, all
you have to do is train
like one! Probably! ♪
choice_data_list: ごもっともですが……無理じゃないですか？
choice_data_list_en: You're quite right, but... isn't that impossible?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Now, as you yourself suggested, let's try
it out
and see how things work out. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Let's get going, Trainer... Or rather,

<username>!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready? Let's start off with a turf
sprint!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Not bad! Your speed is impressive! ♪
Though I'd
still easily outpace you if I
hightailed it! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Next on the menu is breaststroke! Build
up that
stamina now and it'll be smooth
sailing for you in
the future! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Your swimming style reminds me of the
way I
looked while frantically searching
for a needle I
dropped into a pond.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Finally, we can't forget about training
your
strength! ♪ And that'll come
naturally by running
on dirt! Probably!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'll be here waiti—ack! When did all this
dirt get in
my heels?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Well done! ☆ Looks like you worked up
a great
sweat! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh c'mon, don't play dumb! We're
finally able to
get to the main event
now!
choice_data_list: あの……どうして保健室に？
choice_data_list_en: Um... why are you in the infirmary?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Now that you're done with training... let
me give
you a little poke! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Relax, relaaax! It'll be quick and
painless, so don't
you worry! ☆
choice_data_list: ま、まだ心の準備が……！！
choice_data_list_en: I-I'm not mentally prepared yet...!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Annnd poke!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Somehow... I feel as though I'm brimming
with
power! However...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hm, that's a worrying side effect! Maybe
this is a
sign that I still have much to
improve...
choice_data_list: 指先がしびれるような……？
choice_data_list_en: Do your fingertips feel numb...?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
This might have been the fault of my

acupuncture, but it might have also been
because
I went too easy on your training!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! We'll have to step up your
training a
couple notches for you to
become more like an
Umamusume!
choice_data_list: 結構、鍛えられたと思いますけど
choice_data_list_en: I think we got a pretty good workout in, though.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
If the training you did today was, say,
level one...
I get the feeling we'll need
you to go all the way
up to level three!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ For my sake... No, for the
future of
acupuncture and Umamusume,
you must work
hard to become an
Umamusume yourself!
choice_data_list: ぜ、善処します……
choice_data_list_en: I-I'll do what I can...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You can do it,

<username>! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? I didn't quite catch what you said!
Could
you repeat that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without waiting for a reaction, I quickly
turn and
leave, but...
choice_data_list: 俺には荷が重いかと！
私には荷が重いかと！
choice_data_list_en: I think that's too heavy a burden for me!
I'm afraid that's a bit too much for me to handle!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hold it right there, practice partner!
Where do
you think you're going?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: You can't shake me off that easily! They don't call me Ol' Stubborn Sasami for nothing!
choice_data_list: 追いかけてきた！？
choice_data_list_en: They're chasing after us!?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: No worrieeees!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! ♪ Resistance is futile!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Surrender your body to me, the
legendary
acupuncturist Sasami
Anshinzawa! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Annnd poke!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! Well? Do you feel tremendous
power
coursing through your veins?!
choice_data_list_en: Aaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa, what? What's the matter?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Oh... That's that, I guess...
choice_data_list: 目が……回る……
choice_data_list_en: My head's... spinning...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Well, would you look at the time? I
should get
going! Bye! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today I've learned the hard way to never
go
along with sketchy deals... I vow to
teach my
trainee the same lesson during
our next session.
